```{r,echo=F,warning=F}
options(scipen=99)
pm = sample(1:20,1)

ss = c("PM more","PM over","PM increase","PM markup","PM growth","PM up","PM higher")

s = sample(ss,1)
s = gsub("PM",paste0(pm,"%"),s,fixed=T)

```

Question
========

What is the scale factor associated with the phrase "`r s`"?

Solution
========

The phrase indicates a growth or increase, so divide by 100 and then add to 1.

$$1+\frac{`r pm`}{100}~=~`r 1+pm/100`$$


Meta-information
============
extype: num
exsolution: `r round(1+pm/100,2)`
exname: growth_factor
